items.stem: A team keeps fixing the same defect each week. Which lean practice most directly addresses this?

options.text: Root-cause analysis to find and remove the underlying cause
options.rationale: Correct: recurring defects signal an unaddressed root cause, not just symptoms.
Buffering with inventory hides the problem rather than solving it.

options.text: Adding a final inspection step only
options.rationale: Inspection catches defects but does not remove the cause.

options.text: Running faster to make up lost units
options.rationale: Speeding up without fixing the cause multiplies defects.

items.explanation: Correct: recurring defects signal an unaddressed root cause, not just symptoms.
